description: This file provides a singleton class 'DatabaseHelper' that manages low-level database operations such as creation, insertion, update, deletion, and querying for a notes application using the sqflite plugin.

classes.name: DatabaseHelper
classes.description: A singleton class handling low-level database operations for notes, encapsulating database creation, connection, and CRUD operations.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Provides the singleton instance of DatabaseHelper.

methods.name: database
methods.description: Asynchronously returns the database instance, initializing it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: _initDatabase
methods.description: Initializes the database by setting the file path and creating the database with the onCreate callback.

methods.name: _onCreate
methods.description: Creates the notes table with fields for id, title, content, pinned status, color, created_at, and updated_at.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a record into a specified table with conflict replacement strategy.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates records in a specified table based on where clause and arguments.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes records from a specified table based on where clause and arguments.

methods.name: queryAll
methods.description: Queries all records from a specified table, optionally ordered.

methods.name: rawQuery
methods.description: Executes a raw SQL query with optional arguments.
